data.text: Operator answers 2026-10-22 to batch-gates Q1-Q10, all equal to recommended defaults: Q1/Q2 mode default off now; ci batching for ddflow after BG-ci; full batching (reviews) later; triggers 4 items / 800 changed lines / 45 min. Q3/Q4/Q5 review unit 400 lines; a reviewer is always used (no skipping the second reviewer on tiny batches); items touching risk-globs review alone. Q6/Q7 fold B-batch-integration into BG-ci; bug_hunt and dedupe stay per item. Q8/Q9/Q10 company floor knob exists (a company can forbid full mode); on a red batch bisect, drop the culprit (return it to its agent) and land the rest; keep the batch record in the log forever.

data.alternatives: ci on by default now (unproven, rejected); full first (reviews are the riskier part, rejected); never batching (forgoes the speed-up, rejected).
data.consequences: Existing projects see no change until they opt in; rollout is staged and gated on BG-ci and the BG-measure numbers.
data.decision: [batch].mode defaults to off (today's per-item behaviour). ddflow itself turns on ci (batched full-suite checks) once BG-ci is green. full (batched model reviews) is enabled later, only after measurement. Operator 2026-10-22: Q1 answered yes to the recommended default.
data.title: Batch mode default is off; ci for ddflow after BG-ci; full later

data.alternatives: Count only (about an hour wait, rejected); larger line cap (review quality falls, rejected).
data.consequences: Defaults are config knobs in [batch], tunable per project; BG-trigger tests encode the table.
data.context: Proposal D-BG-4; merges arrive about 3.7 per hour so the age trigger keeps latency near today's.
data.decision: A batch closes at the first of max_items=4, max_lines=800, max_age_min=45 (plus wave end or queue run --now). A lone item at the age limit runs alone. Operator 2026-10-22: Q2 yes.
data.title: Batch triggers: 4 items, 800 changed lines, 45 minutes

data.alternatives: 200 (more review calls, little gain); 800 (finding recall drops).
data.consequences: Tunable with the replay corpus; a company floor may cap it (D-BG-Q8).
data.decision: [batch] review_unit_lines defaults to 400 (upper end of the 200-400 range and the measured knee). Cuts fall on member boundaries first. Operator 2026-10-22: Q3 yes.
data.title: Review unit size is 400 changed lines

data.alternatives: Skip reviews under N lines (rejected: unmeasured, weakens the enforced reviewer rule).
data.consequences: Small batches still cost one combined review; the knob stays so a project may loosen it later, within company floors.
data.context: Proposal D-BG-6 size policy; the cross-family reviewer rule is enforced, not requested.
data.decision: A tiny batch never skips the second reviewer; skip_below_lines defaults to 0 and no tiny-batch path relies on ci+standards alone. Operator 2026-10-22: Q4 no skipping.
data.title: A reviewer is always used: skip_below_lines stays 0

data.alternatives: Treat risk items like others in a batch (rejected: findings attribution and depth suffer).
data.consequences: Risk-heavy streams batch less in full mode; ci batching is unaffected.
data.context: Proposal D-BG-2 and D-gate-economy-r3 (b): review depth is the larger of size and risk.
data.decision: Members on a risk glob (security, engine, hooks, lease) or tier:deep are reviewed alone, never inside a shared review unit (risk_globs_alone; list can only grow under a floor). Operator 2026-10-22: Q5 yes.
data.title: Items touching risk globs review alone

data.consequences: Its needs P-unify/GR-itemgraph and the ItemGraph note carry into BG-ci (GR-itemgraph already needed via BG-trigger).
data.context: Proposal D-BG-10; same idea for ci only.
data.decision: B-batch-integration is subsumed by BG-ci and folded into it with ddflow task fold when BG-ci starts; its test (red second member named, first lands) becomes a BG-e2e case. Do not run both. Operator 2026-10-22: Q6 yes.
data.title: Fold B-batch-integration into BG-ci

data.alternatives: Batch them (rejected: they reason over one item's diff, attribution blurs).
data.consequences: Per-item cost of those two gates is unchanged; revisit only with measurements.
data.context: Proposal D-BG-2 left this to a later decision.
data.decision: bug_hunt and dedupe are not moved to the batch, in any mode; they run per item. Operator 2026-10-22: Q7 no move.
data.title: bug_hunt and dedupe stay per item in full mode

data.alternatives: No floor (rejected: regulated projects need one).
data.consequences: BG-policy implements strictest= floors with tests that project or flag cannot loosen them.
data.decision: [batch] mode has a tighten-only company floor (D-org-config): a company may cap it at ci or off, forbidding full. review_unit_lines and skip_below_lines get maxima, risk_globs_alone can only grow, lower max_items is stricter. Overriding goes through the approvals engine, single-use. Operator 2026-10-22: Q8 floor knob exists.
data.title: Company floor knob exists; a company can forbid full mode

data.alternatives: All-or-nothing (one bad member blocks the rest, rejected).
data.consequences: Needs services/bisect.ddmin reuse in BG-fanout; interacting pairs are dropped together.
data.decision: On a red batch, ddmin over members finds the culprit set; it is dropped, recorded failed on those members only and returned to its agent with the failing output; the rest are re-run once on the reduced set (unless proven green) and land. A second red on the same set is a flake report and the batch dissolves into per-item merges; max_culprit_runs default 8. Operator 2026-10-22: Q9 drop and land.
data.title: Red batch: bisect, drop the culprit, land the rest

data.alternatives: Prune after N days (rejected: breaks audit and replay).
data.consequences: Log growth per batch is small (members, shas, manifest); BG-record must keep fold and replay cheap.
data.context: Proposal D-BG-3; the event log is the source of truth.
data.decision: batch.formed, gate_started/finished, culprit, landed and dissolved events are never pruned; they are the audit of which tree each gate outcome covered. Operator 2026-10-22: Q10 forever.
data.title: The batch record stays in the log forever
